summary: 本轮检索到两项与灵巧机器人手直接相关的新公开工作：其一是面向人手到多种机器人灵巧手/手臂形态编辑的 HandEdit 基准，其二是关于类人双臂灵巧操作中初始姿态依赖与手选择偏差的诊断研究。两者都在 2026-08-12 首次公开，且都把“手”作为核心变量，因此纳入本次更新。
summary_en: This run found two newly public works directly related to dexterous robot hands: HandEdit, a benchmark for editing egocentric human-hand imagery into multiple robotic hand and hand-arm embodiments, and a study diagnosing initial-pose-dependent hand-selection bias in humanoid dual-arm dexterous manipulation. Both were first public on 2026-08-12 and both place the hand as a central variable, so they are included in this update.

items.title: HandEdit: A Unified Benchmark for Egocentric Human-to-Robot Dexterous Hand Image Editing
items.authors_or_org: Zhenjie Yang, Xingyu Jiao, Guopeng Zhong, Shuzhe Yang, Shi Che, Chao Wu, Chenyu Jiang, Dongjie Zhang, Yideng Zhang, Zheng Zhang, Muyun Jiang, Haisheng Su, Shuang Jin, Donghang Zhang, Chao Yang, Li Chen, Hongyang Li, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiaosong Jia, Junchi Yan
items.relevance: 它直接面向灵巧机器人手的 embodiment-aware 数据与评测，目标是把人类手臂/手的第一视角图像编辑成多种机器人灵巧手与手臂形态，是灵巧手数据扩展与表征学习的核心基础设施工作。
items.relevance_en: It is directly about embodiment-aware data and evaluation for dexterous robot hands, aiming to edit egocentric human-hand imagery into multiple robotic hand and hand-arm embodiments. That makes it foundational infrastructure for dexterous-hand data scaling and representation learning.
items.novelty_signal: 2026-08-12 首次公开的 arXiv 基准数据集与评测协议，规模很大，并且明确提出了手-only 与手臂两条评测轨道。
items.novelty_signal_en: First public arXiv release on 2026-08-12, introducing a large-scale benchmark and evaluation protocol with explicit hand-only and hand-arm tracks.
items.analysis_zh: HandEdit 的主要工作是构建一个统一的 embodiment-aware 图像编辑数据集与基准，用于把第一视角的人手/手臂图像转换成多种机器人灵巧手形态。它解决的问题是：现有大量人类手部视频虽然可用于学习，但人手与机器人手在外观、关节构型和相机视角上差异巨大，通用图像编辑模型缺少足够的 embodiment 先验。方法上，作者汇集了来自五个来源的超过 2 亿个编辑实例，覆盖 26 种 URDF，并设计手-only 与手臂两条评测轨道，结合通用相似度、VLM 判别和 embodiment-aware 指标，对 11 个代表性编辑基线做系统评测。实验表明该基准能有效区分不同方法在一般视觉相似性与机器人形态一致性上的能力，结果说明 embedding-aware 编辑仍然是把人类视频转化为可用于灵巧手学习数据的关键瓶颈。总体来看，HandEdit 为更大规模的灵巧手预训练和跨形态学习提供了重要基础，但公开信息中尚不足以判断它是否已经在真实机器人上完成闭环操作验证，且基准本身仍主要聚焦图像编辑而非抓取控制。
items.analysis_en: HandEdit’s main contribution is a unified, embodiment-aware image-editing dataset and benchmark for transforming egocentric human hand and arm imagery into multiple robotic dexterous hand embodiments. It addresses a concrete problem: large amounts of human hand video are available, but the appearance, articulation, and camera viewpoint gaps between human and robot hands make direct co-training difficult, and generic image-editing models lack robot-body priors. Methodologically, the authors assemble more than 200M editing instances from five source datasets, cover 26 URDFs, and define two evaluation tracks, hand-only and hand-arm, with URDF-conditioned scoring. They evaluate 11 representative editing baselines using a metric suite that mixes generic similarity, VLM-based judgments, and embodiment-aware measures. The experiments show that the benchmark separates models that are visually plausible from those that better preserve robot embodiment consistency, and the reported results suggest embodiment-aware editing remains a key bottleneck for turning human videos into useful dexterous-hand training data. Overall, HandEdit is an important infrastructure piece for scalable pretraining and cross-embodiment learning, but the public information is insufficient to tell whether it was validated in closed-loop real-robot control, and the work is still centered on image editing rather than manipulation policy learning.

items.title: Policy-Induced Hand Priors in Humanoid Dual-Arm Manipulation: Diagnosing and Mitigating Initial-Pose Dependence
items.relevance: 它研究的是类人双臂灵巧操作中的手选择与初始姿态依赖，手臂/手的协同与哪只手接任务是核心变量，属于双臂灵巧操作的直接机制分析。
items.relevance_en: It studies hand selection and initial-pose dependence in humanoid dual-arm dexterous manipulation, where arm/hand coordination and which hand takes the task are central variables. That makes it a direct mechanism study for bimanual dexterous manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: 2026-08-12 首次公开的 arXiv 论文，提出 HandPriorScore、residual hand bias 和 target responsiveness 等诊断量，并报告了跨多个策略和 17 个初始配置的系统评估。
items.novelty_signal_en: First public arXiv paper on 2026-08-12, introducing HandPriorScore, residual hand bias, and target responsiveness, with systematic evaluation across multiple policies and 17 initial configurations.
items.analysis_zh: 这篇工作的主要工作是诊断并缓解类人双臂灵巧操作中的初始姿态依赖，特别是 VLA 策略在不同初始构型下会形成“政策诱导的手偏好”。它解决的问题是：仅看总体成功率会掩盖某些姿态下的失败模式，以及策略在左右手选择上的系统性偏置。方法上，作者提出 HandPriorScore、residual hand bias 和 target responsiveness 三个指标，分析多个策略在 17 个初始配置上的表现，并进一步考察腕部相机对手选择和任务成功率的影响。实验显示，同一姿态在不同策略下会产生明显不同的成功率，而单一策略在不同姿态间也存在较大波动；扩大训练数据中的初始姿态覆盖能显著提高鲁棒性，对低表现配置做定向增强也能提升成功率。总体结论是，初始姿态覆盖和数据构成对双臂灵巧操作很关键，但公开信息对所用机器人平台、任务种类和失败案例细节披露有限，因此对于真实系统的外推仍需谨慎。
items.analysis_en: The main contribution of this paper is a diagnosis and mitigation study of initial-pose dependence in humanoid dual-arm dexterous manipulation, where VLA policies can develop a policy-induced preference for one hand or the other under different starting configurations. It tackles a practical problem: aggregate task success can hide pose-specific failures and asymmetric hand selection behavior. The method introduces three diagnostic measures, HandPriorScore, residual hand bias, and target responsiveness, and evaluates multiple policies across 17 initial configurations while also examining the effect of wrist-camera observations on hand choice and task outcome. The experiments show strong pose-policy interactions: the same pose can lead to very different success rates depending on the policy, and a single policy can vary substantially across poses. The reported results indicate that increasing coverage of initial poses in training improves robustness, and targeted augmentation around a low-performing pose raises its success rate. In conclusion, initial-pose coverage and dataset composition matter a great deal for bimanual dexterous manipulation, but the public information is limited on the exact robot platform, task suite, and failure cases, so extrapolation to other real systems should be cautious.

caveats: 本轮按增量更新处理，新增条目均为 2026-08-12 首次公开的 arXiv 工作；未发现需要回填到更早日期的重大更新。
